description.value: Dublin Calling is a three-floor sports bar on downtown Vancouver's Granville Street, positioning itself as the city's sports headquarters with 15 big-screen TVs and 12+ beers on tap. Operated by The MRG Group, it offers a full food menu including brunch and late-night options, regular trivia and music bingo events, and group bookings for up to 20 people. The venue is 19+ after 10 PM and is non-smoking throughout.
